title: Sophie personal devx scratchpad: SDK doc gaps & mini-samples
content:
Morning quick dump — not polished. Keep for sprint planning + 1:1 follow-up.

PRIORITIES (today):
- finish sample-app readme for 'chat-streaming-demo' (blocked on streaming snippet clarity).
- triage doc gaps reported by QA: functions calling examples (JS + Py) are inconsistent.
- small tutorial fix: outline step numbers are wrong on step 4 -> step 3 mismatch.

OPEN QUESTIONS:
- should we standardize on `client.chat.stream()` or `client.generate.stream()` naming in SDK? Kai prefers chat.*. Leah thinks generate.* is clearer for non-chat models. Need final call.
- auth examples: examples use API_KEY env var, but security team prefers KMS snippet link. Add short paragraph linking to Private KMS guide.

NOTES / QUICK TODOS:
[ ] chat-streaming-demo README: add minimal server example (express + eventstream), show reconnect logic for dropped connections.
[ ] update Py snippet to use async for stream consumption (currently synchronous example is misleading).
[ ] add a tiny gif (4–6s) showing streaming tokens appended in the UI — ask design for export.
[ ] file bug: JS code block in tutorial has backticks escaped wrong (renders incorrectly). File GH issue if not fixed by EOD.

SNIPPETS + EXAMPLES (for copy-paste)
- JS streaming skeleton (to paste into README):

const stream = await client.chat.stream({ model: 'redwood-chat-3b', messages });
for await (const chunk of stream) {
  // append chunk.text to UI
}

- Py async streaming hint:

async for token in client.chat.stream(model='redwood-chat-3b', messages=messages):
    ui.append(token.text)

UX / Docs GAPS I NOTICED:
- Quickstart has no "how to test locally" section — we should add a small paragraph about using local env, mocking responses with `--mock` flag.
- Missing migration note for users upgrading from v1.x: breaking change in batch embeddings param name (`inputs` -> `items`). Put a bold callout.
- Error handling: examples show try/except but never explain retry/backoff approach — add a small subsection with recommended backoff (exponential, capped 5s, jitter). Link to SRE retry policy.

SAMPLE-APP IDEAS (micro, 1-day each):
1) "Quick Reranker" — small Node app using embeddings + cosine rerank, shows full pipeline and latency numbers. Useful for adoptability.
2) "Docs Summarizer" — serverless sample (AWS Lambda) showing chunking + batching recommendations in Optimize.
3) "Private-deploy smoke test" — recipe for customers on private deployment to validate KV cache behaviour under cold start.

MEETING NOTES (1:1 w/ Kai 2026-03-12):
- agree to standardize on chat.* for high-level UX; keep generate.* alias for compatibility.
- Kai to merge PR that adds `--mock` flag to CLI by next Tue.
- Leah to provide design gif assets; asked for 3 variants (dark/light/minimal).

ACTION ITEMS (assigned):
- Sophie: update chat-streaming README + add JS/Py streaming snippets (ETA 2026-03-13).
- Kai: prepare RFC for naming conventions (chat.* vs generate.*) and share in #devx by Fri.
- Leah: export 2 sample gifs and drop in share drive (comment when ready).
- QA: retest tutorial after JS snippet fix (ticket DOCS-1123).

RANT / QUICK THOUGHTS (brain dump):
- we keep duplicating the same tiny example across three pages; should centralize canonical snippets in a single "snippets" micropage and include by reference. saves drift.
- small friction: the code playground autoformats and sometimes renames variables (u/ vs user) — include note to contributors.

POTENTIAL HEADLINE FOR PR: "docs(devx): clarify streaming examples + add local test guide"

If stuck: pivot to small wins — get the README updated, fix the escaped backticks, add the gif placeholder. That alone will reduce the number of questions in #devx by a lot.

End of dump. Will clean and move into PR template after lunch.
notes_summary: scratchpad for streaming SDK examples, JS+Py snippets, sample-app ideas, tasks assigned, meeting notes with Kai and Leah, migration + error handling doc gaps.
